claims.claim: Static scan of the named dispatch surfaces (tools/lib/codex-invocation.mjs, tools/lib/codex_invocation.py) finds ZERO caret-bearing revision call sites (^{commit}, HEAD^, ~^ forms) - no git helper emits a bare ^ through PowerShell.

Both-states control: on this box under pwsh7, the single-quoted form dereferences the tag to the exact rev-list ground truth while the BARE caret form demonstrably errors (PS ^ is the escape character) - the hazard the estate rule warns about is real here, not hypothetical.
Second-shell cross-check: tag-to-commit dereference under pwsh7 (quoted) and Git Bash (quoted) both equal the `git rev-list -n 1 <tag>` ground truth - zero divergence.

negative_controls.description: The bare `git rev-parse --verify v1.2.3^{commit}` under pwsh7 errors (escape-char consumption), while the quoted form returns the ground-truth commit - proving the probe can see the hazard it guards against.
